title: Follow the revised cache decision

history.text: Use a Map for the cache. It is faster for the hot path and we do not need to serialize it today.
Implemented with a Map. set/get are O(1), snapshot returns the Map itself.

Correction, and this supersedes the Map instruction: the cache must survive JSON.stringify for the persistence layer. Do not use a Map anywhere in src/cache.js. Use a plain object, and snapshot must return a plain object.
Understood. The final decision is a plain object. The current src/cache.js is still the Map version, so it will fail the serialization test until I revise it.
